review.location: Reviewed Emaar’s published point and regional map plus the project marker and four travel estimates on brochure physical page 3. Kept the estate scope and proposed transit qualification.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed 129 physical pages in seven Emaar originals, with the podium from Emaar and six building packs from identified broker mirrors. Retained 121 complete sheets and 157 area panels. Building 2A page 25 is a back page. In the 1B pack physical page 9 names 1A in the heading and 1B in the key plan. Physical page 17 shortens the heading to Building 1 and specifies 1B in the key plan. Checked the square-foot column independently where the printed metric unit is mislabeled. Printed totals and rounding differences were retained.
